ammonia.reason: Fresh unripened whey cheese with minimal proteolysis-deamination, QDA ammonia near absent.

animal_barnyard.reason: No washed-rind bacteria; p-cresol indole scatole not detected in fresh whey curd.

bitter.reason: No ripening so minimal bitter hydrophobic peptides; high fat masks bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium; methyl ketones 2-heptanone 2-nonanone only trace RPA.

browning.reason: Fresh pale curd; lactose plus whey protein Maillard only on grilling not in fresh cheese.

buttery.reason: High ovine cream fat with C4-C12 delta-lactones plus diacetyl-acetoin from citrate fermentation.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Early lipolysis releasing butanoic hexanoic octanoic decanoic acids predominant VOCs but low vs aged.

creaminess.reason: Very high fat-in-dry-matter >70% with denatured whey-protein emulsion gives smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Fine heat-set whey protein gel deforms rather than fractures, not acid-crumbly like feta.

firmness.reason: Soft heat-precipitated whey-protein gel with high moisture, sliceable-spreadable.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde 2-phenylethanol; faint floral lactones from ovine milk fat.

fruity.reason: Trace ethyl octanoate-decanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Sheep-goat feta whey C6-C10 acids including methyl-branched octanoic types diluted by sweet cream.

malty_nutty.reason: No aging or Strecker aldehydes 2-methylbutanal 3-methylbutanal; no pyrazines.

melt.reason: Denatured whey proteins do not flow; softens and oils slightly but holds shape on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No mould or Geotrichum; 1-octen-3-ol 1-octen-3-one not detected.

oil_off.reason: High free milkfat releases slight oil on warming-cutting limited by whey-protein emulsification.

smoky.reason: Traditionally unsmoked; no wood-smoke guaiacol phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mild lactic acid from residual lactose fermentation pH ~5.6; acetic acid not major.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata kneading; no aligned paracasein network.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Whey heated to 85-90C denaturing beta-lactoglobulin releasing H2S sulfides and cooked-milk notes.

sweet.reason: Residual whey lactose-carbs ~1.5-2% plus high-fat milky sweetness with low salt-acid.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate; minimal proteolysis of whey proteins in unripened cheese.
